text: For the Chief Musician; on a stringed instrument. [A Psalm] of David. Hear{H8085} my cry,{H7440} O God;{H430} Attend{H7181} unto my prayer.{H8605}
From the end{H7097} of the earth{H776} will I call{H7121} unto thee, when my heart{H3820} is overwhelmed:{H5848} Lead{H5148} me to the rock{H6697} that is higher{H7311} than I.
For thou hast been a refuge{H4268} for me, A strong{H5797} tower{H4026} from{H6440} the enemy.{H341}
I will dwell{H1481} in thy tabernacle{H168} for ever:{H5769} I will take refuge{H2620} in the covert{H5643} of thy wings.{H3671} {H5542}
For thou, O God,{H430} hast heard{H8085} my vows:{H5088} Thou hast given{H5414} [me] the heritage{H3425} of those that fear{H3373} thy name.{H8034}
Thou wilt prolong{H3254} the king's{H4428} life;{H3117} His years{H8141} shall be as many{H1755} generations.{H1755}
He shall abide{H3427} before{H6440} God{H430} for ever:{H5769} Oh prepare{H4487} lovingkindness{H2617} and truth,{H571} that they may preserve{H5341} him.
So will I sing{H2167} praise unto thy name{H8034} for ever,{H5703} That I may daily{H3117} perform{H7999} my vows.{H5088}
